title: The $U^2$ norm as the $\ell^4$ norm of the Fourier spectrum
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function, with Gowers uniformity norm $\|f\|_{U^2}$ and Fourier coefficients $\hat f(S) = \E_x[f(x)\chi_S(x)]$ indexed by the subsets $S \subseteq [n]$. Then
\[
  \|f\|_{U^2}^4 \;=\; \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} \hat f(S)^4 .
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional hypercube
